criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,600,000 (2 x ($6,300,000 - $5,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.2 is stated as $5,625,000 but 10% of the $45,000,000 Purchase Price is $4,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 7 April 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 7 April 2033 (72 months after Closing).

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Yarrow Analytics Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Flags that the board minutes and the disclosure letter are inconsistent about litigation.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,600,000 and the Seller's $2,200,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
